Zelensky blasts Trump-Putin diesel deal as Russian strikes kill 16
items.description: Zelensky said Russia was expressing its 'thanks' with the attack on a residential building in Zaporizhzhia.

items.title: Russian attack on Ukrainian city kills 15, a day after Trump eases diesel sanctions on Moscow
items.description: Fifteen people, including three children, were killed in a Russian attack on the southern Ukrainian city of Zaporizhzhia on Saturday, a day after US President Donald Trump announced a deal to lift sanctions on Russian diesel, in a major setback for Kyiv. Our correspondent Gulliver Cragg tells us more.

items.title: Drone strike by Sudan paramilitary kills 41 near Ethiopian border, rights group says
items.description: Eight children are said to be among those killed by the strike, which hit a gathering of displaced people.

items.title: Why is the US sanctioning the International Criminal Court?
items.description: The sanctions targeting the ICC, which prosecutes humanitarian crimes, are the latest move by the US against the court.

items.title: Photos: What a year of ceasefire in Gaza looks like
items.description: It has been one year since Hamas released the remaining Israeli hostages and President Trump promised an end to the war, but Palestinians say the past 12 months have been a ceasefire in name only.

items.description: Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha warned on Friday, Oct. 9, that easing sanctions on Russian diesel will not calm global energy markets or bring peace to Ukraine, arguing that Vladimir Putin interprets such steps as Western weakness. items.title: Eritrean troops in Ethiopia raise fears of a regional war
items.description: Ethiopia and Eritrea are trading blame for confrontations in Tigray amid international calls for restraint. Their respective allies have the potential to catapult the conflict into a regional war.

items.title: World News in Brief: ‘Horrific’ attack in Sudan, Israeli incursions in Syria intensify, most women and girls homeless in Gaza
items.description: A suspected drone strike has left at least 40 dead in Sudan’s Blue Nile State – near the Ethiopian border - according to initial reports from the ground, according to UN Spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric. Most of the casualties were women and girls.

items.title: Dozens Killed In Russian Strike On Passenger Buses In Kramatorsk
items.description: Dozens of people were killed in a Russian strike on the Ukrainian city of Kramatorsk on October 8, according to local authorities, a day after another deadly barrage killed at least 25 people across Ukraine.

items.title: EU Lifts Belarus-Related Sanctions on Russian Billionaire Gutseriev – RFE/RL
items.description: The billionaire remains subject to separate EU sanctions linked to Russia’s war in Ukraine.

items.title: In Ukraine, holding on to childhood in a time of war
items.description: As war in Ukraine continues into its fifth year, some children have only known war. The Monitor revisits three young families striving to live full lives amid Russia’s military invasion.
